title: Two pianists shape a nocturne
work: Nocturne in E♭ major, Op. 9 No. 2
question: How do Lévy and Prati give space to the melody and its ornaments?
intro: Lévy’s Musopen performance is dated circa 2014; Prati’s live account comes from Madrid on 24 November 2015. The automatic piano map covers Lévy 0–260 and Prati 0–290 seconds, excluding the final low-level tails. Compare the sustained melodic outline with the smaller attacks that decorate it. The planned historical violin transfer is omitted because its upstream source restricts use to scholarship and research.
